SELECT 
  p.fundflux,
  AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxx != 0 AND s.boxy IS NOT NULL 
    THEN (s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx ELSE NULL END) as avg_y_vs_x_diff,
  AVG(CASE WHEN s.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 != 0 AND s.aream2 IS NOT NULL 
    THEN s.aream2 / s.volm3 ELSE NULL END) as area_vol_ratio,
  AVG(CASE WHEN s.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 != 0 AND s.aream2 IS NOT NULL 
    THEN s.aream2 / s.volm3 ELSE NULL END) - 
    (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN volm3 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 != 0 AND aream2 IS NOT NULL 
      THEN aream2 / volm3 ELSE NULL END) FROM scanspatial 
     JOIN projects ON scanspatial.arcref = projects.arcregistry) as above_average
FROM scanspatial s
JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxx != 0 AND s.boxy IS NOT NULL
  AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 != 0 AND s.aream2 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.fundflux
HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN s.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 != 0 AND s.aream2 IS NOT NULL 
  THEN s.aream2 / s.volm3 ELSE NULL END) > 
  (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN volm3 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 != 0 AND aream2 IS NOT NULL 
    THEN aream2 / volm3 ELSE NULL END) FROM scanspatial 
   JOIN projects ON scanspatial.arcref = projects.arcregistry)
ORDER BY p.fundflux
